name: security-gate
description: On-demand AI security review layer modeled on Claude Security: contextual, data-flow-aware vulnerability scanning, adversarial validation of every finding, and human-gated patch proposals. Complements core-guardrails' mechanical gitleaks/semgrep/osv-scanner Stop-hook gate with reasoning a pattern scanner cannot do. Ships no hooks (ADR-0022, ADR-0026) - invoked deliberately via /security-review, never fires on its own.
